persons.name: Bhairavīśaraṇa
persons.evidence: idaṃ pustakaṃ bhairaviśaraṇena (!) lipikṛtaṃ svapaṭhanārthaṃ kāśyāṃ

notes: The colophon gives the name as bhairaviśaraṇena; the cataloguer marked it (!) and normalised it to Bhairavīśaraṇa. I followed the catalogue's form. The copy was made in Kāśī, near Vidyeśvara (written saṃnidho for saṃnidhau), by the grace of the goddess Saṅkaṭādevī. Saṅkaṭādevī and Vidyeśvara are a deity and a shrine, not people, so they are not listed. The colophon gives no date. The scribe made the copy for their own reading, so they are listed as the owner as well.
